rules: Roots: each existing src/reader/modes/<mode>/index.ts plus sharedRoots. rootsAfterCutover join at E5 (the router file still holds the legacy hook until E1).

A runtime edge from a root's closure may land only in the root's own mode directory, an allowedShared path (imported names must be listed in exports) or an allowedExternal package. Never another mode directory, never a legacy path.
Type-only edges are reported and never fail by themselves.
Exact paths and exact export names only; no directory or export wildcards. Once mode roots exist, every allowedShared path must be hit by at least one edge from a mode root.

sharedValueFiles hold zero mutable resources. infrastructureFiles hold exactly infrastructureResources. Mode directories hold no module-let or module-mutable-literal, and module-singleton only when listed in allowedModuleSingletons.

E5 (G1 post-cutover). shellInfrastructure: the runtime closure of src/components/ReaderContainer.tsx intersected with `legacy` must equal exactly these paths (equality, not subset); every other legacy file reached is a violation (Decision #20).

E5. appStandaloneWindow: not in ReaderContainer's runtime closure; reachable from src/main.tsx only through src/App.tsx. deadViews: unreachable from src/main.tsx by any runtime edge (absent files count as unreachable).

E5 ownership scope: every src/reader/** file plus shellFiles. shellFiles hold owner `shell` (hooks/refs/timers allowed; module-let and module-mutable-literal forbidden). legacyRetainedFiles under src/reader/** are excluded explicitly, each with a reason.
